what: Every public table on which the `authenticated` role holds INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE, with the evidence used to decide whether that grant has a committed writer.
discipline: measured, not guessed -- see scripts/security/check-authenticated-write-census.mjs for how each half was derived and what re-checks it.

acl_snapshot.source: throwaway PostgreSQL 17 container seeded by scripts/dev/pgtap-throwaway.sh from the committed clean baseline (supabase/migrations/20260813000000_clean_baseline.sql) plus every later migration that lane can apply
blind_spots: the migrations listed above cannot be applied on the replay lane, so any grant they change is invisible here

production ACLs may have drifted from the committed migrations; the replay snapshot above cannot see that drift and this lane never reads production -- see production_observations for drift an operator measured separately

previous_measurement.delta: guild_war_raw_events (was revoke) dropped by 20260925030000_ps516_drop_guild_war_sync_machinery.sql; no table gained the grant, no decision changed; re-measured again after the war-room shared-teams port: guild_war_meta_teams (new, leader write policy, written by app/api/guild-war/war-room/route.ts on the request client) added as keep-policy-governed; swept set unchanged; on review, role_reconciliation_events moved revoke -> keep-undecided (app/api/guild-roles/reconcile/route.ts casts its db() client to ServiceSupabaseClient and role-reconciler.ts inserts into it), and stored query-builder writes are now followed; later, the Discord dispatcher's command-handler writes were attributed to service-role (SERVICE(discord-dispatch)), so discord_channel_guilds, discord_server_guilds, discord_token_reminders and discord_user_guild_defaults moved keep-undecided -> revoke, swept by 20261006120000_revoke_discord_dispatch_write_grants.sql

acl_snapshot.unapplicable_migrations_assessment: none of the unapplicable migrations grants or revokes INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE for authenticated on a public table or creates a write policy on one (checked 2026-09-25); they can only hide tables the replay never creates, and the migration re-checks every premise (existence, RLS, arming policy, service_role write) against the database it runs on

production_observations.provenance: NOT part of acl_snapshot, which stays replay-only (production_database_read: false). Reported by the operator from a dry run of 20260925080000 on the production primary (db postgres) on 2026-09-25, inside a transaction ending in ROLLBACK; nothing changed. Recorded here as reported, not re-measured by this lane.
production_observations.dry_run_result: refused by the service_role precondition before the drift-tolerance amendment
production_observations.drift: 13 swept tables grant neither authenticated nor service_role INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on production (already hardened): cluster_rankings_refresh_state, guild_raid_boss_difficulty, guild_war_visibility_audit, player_identity_attestation_revocations, player_identity_attestations, player_identity_discord_generation_activations, player_identity_discord_invalidation_events, player_identity_discord_unlink_pending, player_identity_quarantine_events, player_identity_quarantine_evidence, player_identity_quarantine_pii, player_identity_subject_authority_blocks, player_invite_codes
production_observations.consequence: the migration skips (and NOTICEs) swept tables where authenticated already holds no write; the replay-derived keep sets are an upper bound on production

writer_scan.chokepoint: app/lib/db/index.ts -- db() is the cookie-bound anon-key client (PostgREST resolves it to `authenticated`), serviceDb() is the service-role client; app/lib/db/client.ts is the browser half
writer_scan.unresolved_is_conservative: a write site whose client cannot be proved service-role counts AGAINST revoking, never for it
writer_scan.indirect_writers_checked: SECURITY INVOKER functions executable by authenticated, and INVOKER trigger functions, whose bodies name a swept table were enumerated on the replayed database; each one that writes a swept table is called only on a service-role client (serviceDb, ServiceSupabaseClient, createDirectClient with the service key, edge functions) or by cron. Live-only functions are not visible to this check.
writer_scan.cast_taint: a ServiceSupabaseClient-typed receiver is service-role only if no non-test file casts a value to that type and reaches the module through ServiceSupabaseClient-typed parameters; reached modules report UNKNOWN(param-type-cast)
writer_scan.discord_dispatch: a receiver declared `x: Supabase` under app/api/discord/interactions/command-handlers/ is service-role: app/api/discord/interactions/route.ts builds the client the dispatcher passes down with serviceDb(), and no non-test module that reaches a command handler through value imports builds a request client; --scan re-verifies both and reports SERVICE(discord-dispatch)
